name: Bükkaranyos (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, red, white and red, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Bükkaranyos: a blue shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, green and yellow mantling and a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bükkaranyos arms with helm, mantling and scroll
